propositions: The process-local lru_cache on _rendered() in test_wiki_render_corpus.py causes each xdist worker to independently cache and recompute the full wiki corpus (178 bodies, ~884 pandoc spawns), burning ~56s of redundant CPU across three workers versus one serial fill
Pass-1 markdown renders are computed twice: once in _rendered() cache and again in the three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical tests, duplicating work that should be shared

Session-scoped cross-worker disk artifact with digest keying (corpus JSON, renderer source, pandoc version) and per-stratum sharding with rotated probe order eliminates per-worker refills while maintaining all 178 corpus assertions
Inter-process mutual exclusion via os.mkdir with 150s fallback deadline below the 300s timeout guard ensures a blocked worker degrades to local render rather than deadlock on a crashed winner
